class.name: InputMapSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the player's events of the [InputMap] actions, mirrored as [InputMapSettings].

method.name: clear_event
method.description: Clears the slot [param slot] of [param device] of [param action]: the action no longer reacts to that input. The empty slot is stored, so the project binding does not come back after a restart; use [method reset_action] for that.

method.name: find_conflicts
method.description: Returns the actions (except [param ignore_action]) that already have a binding for [param event] in the pending settings. A pressed key matches a binding by keycode, physical keycode or key label. Bindings for a fixed [member InputMapAction.device_id] only conflict with events of that device or of all devices ([code]-1[/code]).

method.name: get_action_deadzone
method.description: Returns the deadzone of [param action] (see [member InputMapAction.deadzone]).

method.name: get_action_names
method.description: Returns the actions this server manages, in the order of the project settings.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Returns the event in the slot [param slot] of [param device] of [param action], or [code]null[/code] if the slot is empty.

method.name: get_event_label
method.description: Returns a short text of [param event] for the UI, such as [code]"Ctrl+S"[/code] or [code]"Joypad A"[/code]. Same as [method InputMapAction.event_to_label].

method.name: get_events
method.description: Returns all bound events of [param action] in the pending settings: keyboard, mouse and gamepad, each by slot.

method.name: get_slot_count
method.description: Returns the number of slots of [param device] that [param action] uses: the highest bound slot plus one, or [code]0[/code] if no slot of the device is bound.

method.name: has_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this server manages [param action].

method.name: rebind
method.description: Binds [param event] to the slot [param slot] of [param action]; the device follows from the event (see [method InputMapAction.get_event_device]). A pressed key is stored by its physical keycode, and the binding reacts to all devices (see [member InputMapAction.device_id]). Other actions that use the same event keep it; check [method find_conflicts] first. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if this server does not manage [param action], and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for event types that can't be bound or a negative slot.

method.name: reset_action
method.description: Gives [param action] back the bindings and the deadzone of the project settings.

method.name: reset_all
method.description: Gives all actions back the bindings of the project settings. Same as [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults].

method.name: set_action_deadzone
method.description: Sets the deadzone of [param action], from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] (see [method InputMap.action_set_deadzone]).
